title: Network coordinator worker remaining remediation implementation
summary: Implement the remaining Network Worker/Coordinator remediation plans for cooperative coordinator drain, provider startup cleanup, worker-state recovery preservation, strict integer parsing, worker local log redaction, WebView stop copy, and focused regressions.
reason: The post-hardening audit found that Network Worker/Coordinator was still not production-safe because coordinator lifecycle evidence ignored remote active claims, ordinary coordinator stop could close HTTP while workers still needed done/heartbeat/log routes, provider startup failures could leave stale runtime state, unreadable worker_state.json could be deleted at startup, selected integer fields still coerced hostile values, worker local cluster-log mirror text was not redacted before local logging, and WebView stop copy implied active work abort.
behavior_before: Remote in-flight coordinator claims were not lifecycle active-work evidence, ordinary coordinator stop could tear down coordinator HTTP during remote active work, worker/coordinator partial startup failures were not fully cleaned, unreadable worker state could be removed during startup, selected integer fields accepted coerced values, worker local mirror logs could carry unredacted secret text, and stop copy described possible abort semantics.
behavior_after: Coordinator lifecycle evidence includes local active jobs and remote in-flight claims, coordinator stop enters cooperative drain when active work exists, provider startup failures clean partial dispatcher/runtime state, unreadable worker_state.json is preserved so claim polling remains blocked, present wrong-type worker-result and done/heartbeat integer fields are rejected, worker local cluster-log mirror text is redacted before local logging, and WebView stop copy describes cooperative stop semantics.
tests_added: WebView static assertion for cooperative lifecycle stop copy

manual_validation.result: pass: Change validation passed: 320 packet(s) valid

rollback_plan: Revert the scoped lifecycle, coordinator, worker-state, protocol/result strictness, WebView copy, focused test, generated summary, and change packet updates made for MP-CHANGE-2026-0615-018. Then rerun the targeted Network lifecycle/worker/security/WebView tests and strict change-control validation.
notes: Implementation packet for REM-NCW-01 through REM-NCW-09. No media-policy, FFmpeg, subtitle/audio, publish/drain, queue semantics, source/scratch/output movement, or cleanup behavior changes are intended.
